blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Wednesday dismissed Caloocan City Rep. Edgar Erice’s description of the almost P60-billion Local Government Support Fund (LGSF) as a “presidential pork barrel,” calling it an attempt to stir controversy. Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said Erice was free to challenge the legality of the LGSF before the Supreme Court but advised him to first examine the process governing the release of the funds to local government units (LGUs). “He should make sure that he has a basis because if he studies the process of how the LGSF is released to the LGUs, he will most likely […]...
